subject: Joint Success Timeline & Ops Ledger — Riverside AI MAP draft
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@riversideai.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-11T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Joint Success Timeline & Ops Ledger — Riverside AI MAP draft

Ethan —

Thanks again for the productive call this morning. Attached is a first-pass Joint Success Timeline (Riverside_MAP_v1.xlsx) that lays out milestones, owners, and target dates so we can all align before the procurement and SOW steps. High level: 

- Phase 0 (Prep): API key exchange, access controls, and security questionnaire — target: week of 11/15 — owner: Riverside
- Phase 1 (Pilot): 2-week test with prefix caching and small traffic — target: 11/30 go/no-go — owner: Redwood Solutions (Soojin) + Riverside Eng
- Phase 2 (Scale): Dedicated pool reservation and SLA onboarding — target: 12/14 — owners: Ben (CS) + Riverside Ops

Please review the milestone owners column and call out any conflicts. I also included a short ops ledger tab that lists checkpoints we typically track during onboarding (credentials, cutover windows, acceptance criteria).

Next steps I propose: 
1) You review and mark tempo changes in the Google doc linked here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1XrRiverside-MAP-v1
2) Ben will confirm CS coverage and onboarding dates
3) Riverside procurement loops in Lena for SOW/redlines

Attachments: Riverside_MAP_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Would you be available for a 30-min check on Thursday to finalize owners?

Marissa
Marissa Cole | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0198
Redwood Inference

From: Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@riversideai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@riversideai.com>, procurement@riversideai.com, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-12T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Joint Success Timeline & Ops Ledger — Riverside AI MAP draft

Marissa — thanks for the draft and the clear breakdown. A couple quick items from our side after internal sync: 

- Procurement will need the SOW and a brief runbook for data handling before the 11/30 pilot. Lena (cc) will lead that.
- Can we push the pilot start by 2 weeks? Our release freeze hits the week of 11/22 and we prefer to start pilot after the holiday cadence. Proposed pilot start: 12/14, scale by 12/28.
- We need clarification on key rotation and KMS integration — is that covered in Phase 0?

If you can update the timeline and include a one-page SOW summary, procurement will start internal approval. We can do a sync Friday if helpful.

Thanks —
Ethan Morris
Director of Platform Engineering, Riverside AI
ethan.morris@riversideai.com | +1 206-555-0123

Date: 2026-11-13T08:45:00-08:00
Subject: .internal: timeline impact and CS coverage for Riverside

Marissa/Soojin —

Saw Ethan's ask to push pilot to mid-December. On CS side we can accommodate, but a few internal notes: 

- Ben will own the 0–30 day success plan: weekly playbacks, acceptance criteria check, and post-pilot health check.
- Need Soojin to confirm the test harness and expected telemetry we’ll collect during pilot (latency, error-rate, token cost).
- If pilot shifts to 12/14, we should reserve dedicated capacity window 12/28–01/11 for scale validation; ops will need lead time to provision.

Soojin — can you update the pilot engineering checklist with required endpoints and sample payloads so I can align CS health checks?

Ben
Ben Carter | Customer Success Lead, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Ethan Morris <ethan.morris@riversideai.com>
Cc: Lena Park <lena.park@riversideai.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T11:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Joint Success Timeline & Ops Ledger — Riverside AI MAP draft

Ethan / Marissa / Ben —

Thanks — I updated the Google doc with a technical ramp section and a test-harness checklist (endpoints, example payloads, target traffic profile). Key notes: 

- KMS integration: Redwood supports customer-managed keys via our KMS connector — we’ll need a short exchange of IAM roles and a test key during Phase 0.
- Telemetry: please include a sample 1-minute and 1-hour traffic trace; we'll instrument latency and model-level token consumption.
- Acceptance criteria for pilot: 95th-pct latency < 600ms for 99% of calls; no data leakage observed in logs; success rate > 99%.

I propose a kickoff/tech-readiness call week of 12/07 (to prep for a 12/14 pilot). Marissa — can you surface doc links and an updated SOW summary?

Soojin
Soojin Lee | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Ethan / Lena —

Appreciate the quick feedback. Per the team discussion we've shifted the timeline to match Riverside's release cadence. Key updates: 

- Pilot start: 2026-12-14 (2 weeks later as requested)
- Scale validation window: 2026-12-28 to 2027-01-11
- Phase 0 checklist now includes KMS role exchange and a short credentials runbook (added to doc).

I've attached a 1-page SOW summary and pushed the MAP spreadsheet update to the Drive link. For signatures, here's a DocuSign envelope to speed procurement review: https://docusign.example.com/envelope/ABC123

Questions outstanding for procurement: any required insurance limits or PO templates we should attach? If you can send the procurement checklist, we’ll return a redline-ready SOW.

Attachments: (1-page SOW summary) — included in Drive and attached to this email

Best,
Marissa

Marissa —

Thanks for the update. Procurement reviewed the SOW summary and sent back a few redlines (attached: redlines_sow_riverside.pdf). Main asks: 

- Standard PO/Net30 terms and a liability cap aligned with our vendor policy
- Appendix A: Data handling specifics — add a requirement for quarterly access reviews
- Signing authority confirmation (who at Redwood signs SOWs <$250k)

We can complete procurement approval within 5 business days after redlines are addressed. Please confirm the SOW owner and a point of contact for signing.
